_comment: Discovery demo (Tavily finds the source): same as policy.tavily.json but with NO watched facts, so a price question about Acme Pro or Acme Team is checked against a page Tavily Search finds. Mount it as /app/policy.json and run the companion with -discover (see DOCKER.md, 'Opt-in: Tavily finds the source'). Tavily Search receives only the query built from the price category's discover template; Tavily Extract receives only the chosen URL.

guard._comment: Requests kept out of the cache entirely. tool_results: a request carrying a tool's result is built from live data. side_effect_tools: a cached text answer would skip the action.

discover._comment: Tavily finds the source. Used only when the companion runs with -discover (DISCOVER=true) and no watched fact covers the question. Tavily Search receives only the query below, with {entities} replaced by the allowlisted names found in the question; the chosen page is then read with Tavily Extract. A discovered page may trigger a refresh but never on_contradicted correct (it is treated as uncache).
